manifoldsR: Fast Low-Dimensional Embeddings and Clustering via 'Rust'

Source: R/manifoldsR-package.R
manifoldsR-package.Rd

R interface to the Rust crates 'manifolds-rs', 'ann-search-rs' and 'evoc-rs'. Builds 2D (or higher) embeddings with UMAP (McInnes et al., 2018) doi:10.48550/arXiv.1802.03426 , t-SNE (van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008) https://jmlr.org/papers/v9/vandermaaten08a.html, densMAP and den-SNE (Narayan et al., 2021) doi:10.1038/s41587-020-00801-7 , PHATE (Moon et al., 2019) doi:10.1038/s41587-019-0336-3 , PaCMAP (Wang et al., 2021) https://jmlr.org/papers/v22/20-1061.html, ForceAtlas2 (Jacomy et al., 2014) doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0098679 , DREAMS and diffusion maps. Also generates approximate nearest neighbour graphs that every method can reuse, plus EVoC and k-means clustering. Multi-threaded via 'Rayon', with f32 or f64 precision.
